title: Get 30% off Kumho Tyres @mycar Tyre & Auto
body:
Deal: Get 30% off Kumho Tyres @mycar Tyre & Auto

[stevea] Tempe tyres is cheaper even with the 30% off.
[battler] What about with Amex stack?
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/965860
[kaikor] BTW how is Tempe service these days? I remember their boys are very rough before
[yippy] There's a couple of branches, I've had experience with the Fairfield East store and the service was great. First place I've been to where they used a torque wrench on my wheel nuts instead of tightening the shit out of them with a rattle gun.
[CheapandUsed] Anyone have a view on the ES31 series for a corolla?
[HerpinDerp] I've got it on a Prius. Bought it as it is a better category for resistance/mileage.
Road noise is fine, no real NVH. I do run higher pressures in the front and have high toe wear, it does have a shit alignment though. Rears are fine.
I'm genuinely impressed for wet performance too.
My weekender is a GSF with PS4S, I honestly can praise the ES31 for what it is.
[sevendollarsfifty] I'm not a car guy, but I have them on my Corolla and I love them. Very good in the wet which is really most of what I care about.
[0jay] Very good in the wet
+1 to all these endorsements
[jazzyman9182] Got some on my Falcon and no issues. Better in the wet than the Bridgestones I had before these.
[ja912son] I'm tossing between ES31 and Bridgestone Ecopia EP300. ah….
[Brick50] I like Kuhmo's, had PS71EV on my Tesla Model 3 but found they were wearing very fast, I reckon i'd only get 15kms out of a set.
Just got a Model Y which needs new tyres, so I decided to go with AC Tyres and get 2 more Pirelli PZ4's at only $304 each inc fitting
I can't speak for the service/legitimacy/grey marketness of the tyres but their pricing is very sharp.
We don't really have Tempe tyres in Vic, so this is our closest option
https://actyres.com.au/tyre-pirelli-255-45r19-104y-p-zero-pz…
[kaikor] Oh I am thinking on PS72 for my Aceman, original set wearing damn fast too, but if Kumho wearing too fast, will need to think of another brand … How are the PZ4? good grip?
[Brick50] I believe PS72 is even softer than PS71? Even though they have the same treadwear rating I believe 320… PZ4 supposedly has a treadwear of 280 but I think they might last longer.
Too early to tell, only had the car a week and i'm not the one who drives it normally. I think they have good grip though
[battler] No deal.
You are probably better to use price match and Amex.
My tyres: 339x4x0.7=950-150=800
Via price match Tempe: 190x4=760-150=610
[bluebluebird] Tempe price match amex - the $150 cashback?
How abt delivery and fitting?
[quikstix] I’ve always lol’’d at these “deals” through mycar even with the promos they still more pricey than most of their competitors..
[Matt P] KUMHO PS72 255/45 R19 104Y
Mycar price incl discount - $1425.20
First link on google. Tyroola
Incl wheel alignment, delivery and fitment at the closest tyre shop to my house
$1,139.60
Sorry to neg OP, its not personal, but they're jacking prices to offer BS discounts.
[Lizard Spock] Don't feel bad for negging, OP is associated and hasn't replied to members' questions since last year. It seems they are just using this platform to advertise.
